info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-Create Creditcard Applications Submit-v1-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Submission API facilitates the process of submitting applications for new credit cards. This API allows users to securely submit their credit card application data, ensuring that all necessary information is collected efficiently. Typically utilized by financial institutions and their systems, this API streamlines the application process for customers, enhancing user experience and operational efficiency. Ideal for use cases involving online banking services and customer onboarding, it ensures a smooth transition from application to approval.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a new application for processing. Ensure all required fields are filled to avoid errors during submission.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the data necessary to submit an application. Please ensure that all required fields are provided and valid.
